name: SM_Stair_Well_L_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset: the joinery needs its own ambient occlusion and wear
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: stair opening in an upper floor, 2.9 x 1.2 m: trimmer curb, four newels, rails and balusters on three sides, the first treads sinking into the dark; entered from the left
known_weaknesses: There is no hole: the floor of the room cannot be cut, so the opening is a black board 5 mm above the floor with five treads painted darker and darker. From the play camera the rails hide most of it; from straight above it is flat. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs or nails are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only.
source_note: the .blend holds the game mesh with its baked set; the dense boards it was baked from are rebuilt by the script (they were removed after the bake to keep the file small)
